cells.ch251_open_row: every open active binary row at k (CH251 ch250/rows_open_binary)
cells.ch261_complete_unit: two-sided at k - 1 and k, k - 1 within 2 h 30 min (CH261 ch252/units_complete)
cells.two_sided_k: open row two-sided at k (0 < bid < ask <= 1)

kind: q0717 LT13 fee-reading probe: counts only, k = 0, uncounted; captures k and k - 1 only; never capture k + 1; no spread or price change, no target, no outcome, no P&L

not_read.capture_k_plus_1: never opened for capture k's counts: every count of capture k uses capture k and capture k - 1 only
not_read.prices_and_targets: best_bid / best_ask are read only inside population_map_ch251.read_rows to set the two-sided flag; no spread, mid or price change is kept or counted; no target, outcome, resolution or P&L
not_read.volume: volume_num and liquidity are not read from the sidecar; the rows reader's liquidity value is discarded

readings.category: as the CH240 / CH251 / CH261 maps (sidecar fee_type / fee_category / series_slugs); a row whose fee_category is the literal 'unknown' is non-crypto there
readings.fee: population_map_ch251.fee_class unchanged (fee_free = fees_enabled non-empty false, or fee_schedule rate <= 0; fee_on = rate > 0; unknown otherwise)
readings.raw_states: fees_enabled: col_absent / blank / true / false / other; fee_schedule: col_absent / empty / unparseable / no_rate_key / rate_nonnumeric / rate_zero / rate_pos (+ sha256[:16] of the text); taker_base_fee: col_absent / blank / zero / pos / other; fee_type, fee_category verbatim (first 64 values); age = created_at before 2026-03-30
readings.reward: MAP reading: clob_rewards of capture k non-empty
